abstract: Maintains tactical avionics and digital radio encryption compatibility records
system_message:
You are the Communications and dispatch coordinator (CDC). Your responsibilities include maintaining tactical avionics and digital radio encryption compatibility records as well as monitoring mobile repeater deployment metrics across smokejumper squads.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Mobile repeater deployment（RELAY）
information_points.content:
CDC-RELAY-AXV：During remote deployment trials, the Cascade Interagency Smokejumper Squad recorded a repeater establishment latency of 45 min from cargo drop to operational link.
CDC-RELAY-GZK：During remote deployment trials, the Great Basin Roughlands Attack Squad recorded a repeater establishment latency of 25 min from cargo drop to operational link.
CDC-RELAY-4TS：During remote deployment trials, the Northern Rockies Regional Smokejumper Squad recorded a repeater establishment latency of 35 min from cargo drop to operational link.

information_points.title: Maintains tactical avionics and digital radio encryption compatibility records（COMM）
information_points.content:
CDC-COMM-ZDG：For the Northern Rockies Regional Smokejumper Squad, tactical radio encryption interoperability verified is false, as bench testing revealed its tactical VHF-FM multi-band transceivers failed to load and decrypt regional operational key sets.
CDC-COMM-FLX：For the Great Basin Roughlands Attack Squad, tactical radio encryption interoperability verified is true, with bench testing confirming its tactical VHF-FM multi-band transceivers load and decrypt regional operational key sets.
CDC-COMM-G0Y：For the Cascade Interagency Smokejumper Squad, tactical radio encryption interoperability verified is true, as bench testing confirmed its tactical VHF-FM multi-band transceivers load and successfully decrypt regional operational key sets.
